about.title: About the portal
about.intro: Meteoportal is the official source of air quality and weather data for Tajikistan: measurements from the monitoring network, forecasts, warnings and health advice in three languages.

agency.title: Operator
agency.text: The Agency runs national ambient air monitoring and hydrometeorological observations and issues forecasts and severe weather warnings. The portal is its public data showcase.

project.title: FINTAJ project
project.text: The portal was developed within FINTAJ, the Finnish–Tajik cooperation project strengthening the hydrometeorological service of Tajikistan.
project.fmi: The donor and technical partner is the Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI): weather forecasts come from SmartMet Server, the air quality forecast from the SILAM model, and warnings from the SmartMet Alert editor in CAP format.

sources.title: Where the data comes from
sources.intro: All external sources are synchronised in the background; if a source is unavailable the portal keeps showing the latest data marked as stale.

stations.title: Monitoring stations
stations.text: PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, SO₂, CO and O₃ concentrations from the Agency's stations: manual entry, imports and automatic sensors. Data passes quality control.

smartmet.title: Weather forecast
smartmet.text: SmartMet Server (FMI): hourly forecast for 3 days and daily forecast for 10 days for cities and districts.

silam.title: Air quality forecast
silam.text: SILAM chemical transport model (FMI): concentration maps and point forecasts for 5 days.

cap.title: Warnings
cap.text: SmartMet Alert messages in CAP 1.2: hazardous phenomena by region with yellow / orange / red levels.

openData.title: Open data
openData.text: Current and historical data is available through a JSON API, CSV exports and embeddable widgets.

languages.title: Languages and accessibility
languages.text: The portal is available in Tajik, Russian and English; the Tajik version is the primary one.

about.accessibility: The interface follows WCAG 2.1 AA: pollution levels are conveyed by colour and label, every action is keyboard-accessible, and dark mode and reduced motion are supported.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.none: Contact details will be published after approval by the Agency.

about.disclaimer: Data is published for information purposes. Official environmental statements are issued by the Agency.

aboutIndex.title: About the air quality index
aboutIndex.intro: How station measurements become five clear levels, which thresholds apply, and how the national index differs from the WHO scale.

operational.title: Operational five-level index

measure.title: Measurement
measure.text: For each pollutant the latest hourly mean is taken (8-hour mean for CO). Only measurements that passed quality control are used.

subindex.title: Pollutant sub-index
subindex.text: The value is compared with the threshold table and gets a level from 1 (good) to 5 (very poor). The position within the band is kept, so the index can also be shown as a number.

max.title: Station index
max.text: The station index is the worst sub-index. The pollutant with the highest sub-index is called dominant and is shown next to the level.

operational.note: This approach is used by operational indices in Europe (for example FMI/HSY): it shows the current situation without smoothing peaks. The thresholds below are edited by the Agency without a software release.

aboutIndex.thresholdsCaption: Concentration thresholds by pollutant and level
aboutIndex.thresholdsHint: Intervals are half-open: the lower bound is included, the upper is not. Units are µg/m³; mg/m³ for CO.
aboutIndex.noScale: The scale has not been configured yet.

colors.title: How to read the colours
colors.level2: Acceptable quality; very sensitive people may notice slight discomfort.
colors.level3: Sensitive groups should reduce prolonged outdoor exertion.
colors.level4: Pollution is noticeable for everyone: limit time outdoors, especially for children and the elderly.
colors.level5: Very high pollution: stay indoors if possible and keep windows closed.
colors.level0: No data, or the data is stale (measurement older than 6 hours).
colors.accessibility: Colour is never the only carrier of meaning: a level label is always shown next to it and a number on the map. Colours are chosen for a text contrast of at least 4.5:1 in light and dark themes.

national.title: National index: ratio to limit values and the IZA
national.ratio: The ratio to limit value compares a concentration with the maximum permissible concentration (daily or single maximum). Up to 1 means the standard is met; levels 2–5 correspond to ratios of 1–2, 2–3, 3–5 and above 5.
national.iza: The composite air pollution index (IZA, RD 52.04.186-89) sums normalised monthly mean concentrations of the five pollutants with the largest contribution, weighted by hazard class: IZA = Σ (q̄ᵢ / MPCᵢ)^Cᵢ. Grades: low < 5, elevated 5–6, high 7–13, very high ≥ 14.
national.note: Limit values and hazard classes are tabular data maintained by the Agency (reference: SanPiN 1.2.3685-21) and are refined on approval.

who.title: WHO guideline scale
who.text: An optional scale based on the WHO Air Quality Guidelines 2021 and interim targets (24-hour means). Available in the API with scale=WHO_24H.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.text: Every measurement is checked: physical range, spikes, stuck sensors and outliers relative to the station's history. Suspect values are reviewed by an operator; only valid and corrected values are published.
quality.stale: If the measurement is older than 6 hours the index is considered stale and shown as grey “no data” — an honest gap is better than an outdated number.

data.title: Open data
data.intro: Measurements, the index, forecasts and warnings are available in machine-readable form — for researchers, the media, app developers and the meteo.tj website.
data.csvHint: Add format=csv to download a table

apiDocs.title: API for developers
apiDocs.intro: Public REST API version 1: read-only, no keys, JSON by default. The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is generated from the same schemas that validate server responses.

apiDocs.corsHint: Requests from any website are allowed (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).

apiDocs.licenseNote: Data is licensed under CC BY 4.0 with attribution; FMI forecasts must credit the Finnish Meteorological Institute.
apiDocs.embedNote: For websites without development there are iframe widgets /embed/aqi, /embed/forecast and /embed/alerts (see Open data).

info.title: Meteoportal of Tajikistan — public API
info.description: Air quality, weather and air quality forecasts, CAP warnings and news of the Agency for Hydrometeorology of the Republic of Tajikistan. Times are UTC (ISO 8601); local time is Asia/Dushanbe (UTC+5).

stations.description: Public stations (except decommissioned) as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with the current index level; 0 means no data or stale.

stationMeasurements.description: Hourly (24h, 7d) or daily local-time (30d, 1y) means of valid measurements with min/max and count. CSV with format=csv.

params.slug: Station address (the slug field from the station list)
params.pollutant: Pollutant code (PM25, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, O3); all pollutants when omitted

indexCurrent.description: The latest computed index of every public station: level, value, dominant pollutant, sub-indices and a stale flag (older than 6 hours).

params.scale: Scale code: NATIONAL_OPERATIONAL (default), WHO_24H or IZA

exceedances.description: Open exceedance events according to the Agency's alert rules (portal channel).

forecast.description: Hourly series and daily aggregates from SmartMet Server; model run time and data producer.

params.hours: Number of hours in the hourly series (1–240)
params.days: Number of days in the daily forecast (1–16)

silamPoint.summary: SILAM air quality forecast for a location
silamPoint.description: Hourly concentrations and levels by pollutant plus a daily summary (local-day mean, level by the worst pollutant).

silamLayers.description: Grid bounds and PNG frames by pollutant and hour of the latest run — for map overlays.

alerts.description: Normalised list of SmartMet Alert warnings in the selected language (with fallback) or GeoJSON polygons for maps.

params.region: Warning region code (DU, SU, KT, GB, RRP)
params.lang: Text language: tg, ru or en

news.description: Published news with excerpt, category, cover and page link.

newsRss.description: The 20 latest news items as RSS 2.0 in the selected language.

regions.description: Regions, Dushanbe and the Districts of Republican Subordination with simplified polygons and centroids.
